principle: A completed request is not a successful job search. Measure whether a user can identify and open a relevant vacancy under their explicit constraints.

model_relevance_at_3.method: relevant=1, partial=0.5, irrelevant=0; uncertain is unscored
model_relevance_at_3.limitation: Model assessment, not human ground truth

hard_constraint_accuracy.method: Share of returned jobs satisfying explicit supported location and date constraints; unknown evidence fails an explicit constraint

actionable_result_ratio.method: Share with title, employer and an HTTP(S) original source URL
actionable_result_ratio.limitation: Does not establish that a link is reachable or vacancy is open

duplicate_url_rate.method: Repeated source URLs divided by returned result count; lower is better

source_availability.method: Sources returning parsable listings divided by sources attempted

retrieval_runtime_ms.method: Interpretation, source retrieval and enrichment/ranking duration; full response time is measured separately in the client and root trace

human_task_success.method: Reviewed user can find a relevant vacancy and open its source without assistance

incremental_value_over_baseline.method: Paired reviewed comparison against Jobinja and Google for the same intent

release_requirements: No fabricated salaries, employers, dates or source links
Unavailable sources never represented as zero jobs
No result counts or pass scores for unassessed relevance
History, cancel, retry, uploads and description expansion usable at 390px
Original source pages and live production MCP checked
